palette.role: Replaceable warm-season colour in low pockets while the permanent planting establishes.

leafHabit.basis: RHS: evergreen perennial often grown as an annual. Outdoors in the UK it does not survive winter, so the habit never shows.

handedness.basis: Darwin: "moves against the sun", i.e. anticlockwise seen from above. One zoo page says "clockwise" with no viewpoint.

attachment.supportNeeds: Light low-level laths or cables with access for replanting every year.

wood.basis: Replanted every year in the UK, so everything that flowers is growth of the current season.

monthsUK.basis: Months read from the RHS season wording (spring = Mar-May, summer = Jun-Aug, autumn = Sep-Nov, winter = Dec-Feb; early, mid and late are the first, second and third month).

flowering.display: Orange, yellow or cream flowers with dark centres.

calendar.note: Replant in late spring once the risk of frost has passed; remove the old vines when they decline.

management.notes: Replant each late spring, train the shoots, water, and clear the dead vines. It offers nothing in winter.
